resolved_notes.issue: PNS narrative previously asserted a different requested projection more strongly than the null theoretical calculation permits.
resolved_notes.resolution: Root changed to non-equivalence is possible / projection not exactly derived in this audit; final wording read and accepted.

resolved_notes.issue: INTERPRETATION referenced STATE.json before it existed.
resolved_notes.resolution: STATE.json now exists; final state and checksum updates remain the root agent closure action.

independence: Independent of master assembler and compared against original frozen aggregates. This reviewer previously authored PNS_AUDIT, so this is not a second independent primary-source review of PNS.

boundary.operations: Read-only aggregate arithmetic, static source inspection, explicit file hashing and review-artifact writing.

checks.excluded: Statistical controls, HRS, HAALSI and other workflow versions; not 30 independent clinical studies.

checks.method: Direct comparison with original RESULTS construction_summaries and references, including entire reference/interval objects.
Recomputed medians and extrema of three retained-draw aggregate estimates in original RESULTS comparisons; checked weighted reference points and interval endpoints.
checks.intervals: Conditional IID row-resampling stability, not survey-design intervals or equivalence margins.

checks.method: Compared original 2026-11-08 IRON_LIPID_AUDIT observed_result summaries and their three aggregate seed_values. Includes all six marginal SD diagnostics.
Compared L03 three projections, iron A/B OR and joint prevalence, and six lipid SD values with existing 2026-11-08 deterministic_checks_completed. No new theory derivation.
checks.SD_unit_conversion: Existing mmol/L theoretical SD multiplied by 38.67 to mg/dL.
checks.null_meaning: Not numerically derived in this audit; not a claim that the analysis cannot run. All 60 main, 15 PNS, six L01/L02 main and two iron rank records retain null.

checks.PNS_and_lipid_iron_evidence_file_existen: All cited file paths exist. Line-by-line reauthentication of all quoted source content was not repeated.

checks.method: Joined Markdown rows to JSON by detail_file/detail_pointer, not position because supplemental SD is grouped separately.
checks.number_rendering: All numeric cells match six-significant-digit rendering of JSON.

checks.method: Recomputed SHA256 of explicitly named allowed files; compared main four-file hashes with actual freeze.json commitments as well as detail bindings. Hashes identify bytes, not truth of source claims.
Read original five model_spec parameter paths; did not infer from sampled correlations.

checks.inference: Descriptive and noncalibrated; five shared-host, common-packet authors, not z statistics or known-population bias.

checks.interpretation: Different E0/E1 author groups are not paired revisions. A counterexample refutes a universal guarantee, not all possible predictive association.

checks.observed_io: Reads three audit JSON files; hashes those inputs; writes the two master outputs. No generator/evaluator or patient-record access in script.
checks.important_logic: Preserves mean versus median, separates supplementary role, leaves main/PNS model-implied values null, converts lipid SD units exactly, and asserts scope and prediction-null constraints.

checks.findings: Source, parameter, implied requested estimand, finite output and empirical reference remain separate. Provenance is not an accuracy ranking. Shared agreement is not calibrated target uncertainty. Proposed cards are retrospective evidence/assumption records; prospective prediction requires separate frozen validation.
checks.PNS_wording: Revised to say the requested projection need not equal the declared coefficient and was not exactly derived here; consistent with null theory fields.

original_source_verification_scope: Prior PNS subaudit directly inspected local INTERSALT BMJ1988 p322 Table II and adjustment footnote image, and selected portions of local PMC9278591.txt. This master review checks that declared scope and the corresponding three source/result hashes. It does not authenticate all original papers. Main and lipid/iron source statements otherwise retain their existing extraction/audit basis.
limitations: Checks verify transcription, operators, units, boundaries and selected mathematical-result reuse, not clinical transport validity or causal error allocation.
No new confidence intervals, model-implied projections, ranking calibration or patient-level analysis were calculated.
Source hash checks establish identity of recorded bytes, not evidential sufficiency.
HbA1c percent units in original main results mean percentage-point outcome differences per stated predictor increment, not relative percentage change.
The historical lipid/iron audit is now directly hash-bound by this review as well as cited by the new detail audit; no original-paper reauthentication was performed.
